notable_absence.finding: INSERT names no capella-role:* management-plane gate at all - only the credential-type-keyed data-plane privilege pair. Confirms the round-2 hypothesis that the management-plane role gate is specific to management/administrative statements (CREATE BUCKET, GRANT/REVOKE, CREATE USER, etc.) and does not apply to ordinary DML statements like INSERT.

cross_product_finding: RECURRENCE of the known anomaly logged in docs-issues/capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json, twice on this one page: 'Starting with Couchbase Server 8.0, you can include up to 15 XATTRs per query' (appears identically in both the Insert Values OPTIONS description and the Insert Select OPTIONS description). Also extends the credential-type/privilege model one step further than earlier batch pages: INSERT is the first statement in this batch to require a *pair* of privileges simultaneously (Write/Query Insert for the insert target, plus Read/Query Read on every keyspace referenced by an optional SELECT or RETURNING clause) rather than a single privilege - minted privilege:capella-advanced-access-query-insert to complete the parallel Write/Read/Insert/Index privilege family alongside the already-promoted capella-basic-access-write and capella-advanced-access-query-index.
